description: Watches a backup directory and files arrival, stale and critical signals when backups stop landing.
name: backup_freshness

signals.description: A newer backup artifact appeared in the watched directory.
signals.name: backup_arrived

signals.description: The newest backup is older than the stale_after_sec tunable.
signals.name: backup_stale

signals.description: The newest backup is older than twice the stale_after_sec tunable.
signals.name: backup_critical
